Third-party licenses for graph-bundle.mjs
=========================================

graph-bundle.mjs (this folder) is a prebuilt, minified ES module that Aeon Matrix's
Second Brain view loads (second_brain.html). That page describes it as one esbuild
bundle of three@0.184 and 3d-force-graph@1.80 with their dependencies. It was
committed prebuilt in 7cccdf2 (2026-07-21); the command that built it is not in
this repository.

How the list below was made (2026-10-03): the bundle keeps only three.js's license
comment and records no package version except three.js's (REVISION "184"). Each
package below is from the dependency tree of 3d-force-graph 1.80.1 with three
0.184.0, as npm resolved it on 2026-10-03, and the bundle was checked for code from
those packages (ngraph.graph's warning strings, kapsule's __kapsuleInstance, the
float-tooltip stylesheet, polished's error URL, tween.js, preact internals,
d3-force-3d's numDimensions, a d3-scale-chromatic palette, tinycolor's
toHexString/getAlpha, and others). The versions are the ones resolved that day;
the bundled copies of the dependencies may be slightly older. A bundler drops code
that is not used, so some of these packages may contribute little or nothing; each
one's notice is included anyway.

Packages and licenses:
  three 0.184.0                        MIT
  3d-force-graph 1.80.1                MIT
  three-forcegraph 1.43.6              MIT
  three-render-objects 1.43.0          MIT
  kapsule 1.16.3                       MIT
  accessor-fn 1.5.3                    MIT
  data-bind-mapper 1.0.3               MIT
  float-tooltip 1.7.5                  MIT
  preact 10.29.8                       MIT
  polished 4.3.1                       MIT
  @babel/runtime 7.29.7                MIT
  @tweenjs/tween.js 25.0.0             MIT
  lodash-es 4.18.1                     MIT
  tinycolor2 1.6.0                     MIT
  ngraph.graph 20.1.2                  BSD-3-Clause
  ngraph.forcelayout 3.3.1             BSD-3-Clause
  ngraph.events 1.4.0                  BSD-3-Clause
  ngraph.random 1.2.0                  BSD-3-Clause
  ngraph.merge 1.0.0                   MIT
  d3-force-3d 3.0.6                    MIT
  d3-binarytree 1.0.2                  MIT
  d3-octree 1.1.0                      MIT
  d3-quadtree 3.0.1                    ISC
  d3-dispatch 3.0.1                    ISC
  d3-timer 3.0.1                       ISC
  d3-selection 3.0.0                   ISC
  d3-scale 4.0.2                       ISC
  d3-scale-chromatic 3.1.0             ISC
  d3-array 3.2.4                       ISC
  internmap 2.0.3                      ISC
  d3-color 3.1.0                       ISC
  d3-interpolate 3.0.1                 ISC
  d3-format 3.1.2                      ISC
  d3-time 3.1.0                        ISC
